purpose: Keep legacy image-space gaze from becoming physical screen geometry without world eye and monitor data.

activities.label: verify missing world geometry fails closed

queries.question: Does the runtime refuse to derive physical screen coordinates from legacy image-space features alone?

assumptions: A world geometry provider will eventually expose both eye centers and a gaze ray.
Legacy image-space features do not have physical monitor semantics by themselves.
The geometry-first contract remains separate from the current production mapper.
kill_tests: Legacy-only input must return UNKNOWN: missing_world_geometry.
The bridge must never mark legacy screen mapping as allowed.
Explicit synthetic world geometry must resolve through the 046 monitor contract.
unknowns: How to estimate world eye centers and camera extrinsics robustly on the current machine.
What calibration protocol supplies those quantities without conditioning on a fixed head pose.
Whether the geometry-first representation improves a human task.
